blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — What was meant to be a peaceful protest coinciding with the start of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit on Sunday escalated into a tense confrontation between rallyists and police, with protesters claiming that authorities were trying to sabotage their program. The protests were slated to start as early as 7:30 a.m. as various groups, under the collective All Workers Unity, planned to gather at the Liwasang Bonifacio freedom park in Manila for a march towards the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC) — the main venue for the 49th Asean Summit.
